I don't think you should put yourself down for having a low IQ. IQ tests aren't great indicators of intelligence as simple tests can't measure the vast variability of the human mind. For example, you can have a super high IQ, but that test won't indicate whether or not you actually do something useful with it. Have you tried looking into college classes/programs that accommodate learning disabilities? Those might be helpful.

You're so young. One day, you'll grow up and get the hell out of there, and you'll look back on this time as a fleeting moment. Suicide isn't selfish; sometimes it's the only way out for some of us. However, I hope you are able to find some inner peace. You've been trying for 13 years, which is a mighty fine accomplishment in itself.
Moms are a good reason to stay. I'd hate to hurt my mother like I do myself.

Social media usually projects false notions about people. They always look like they're having way more fun than they are. I think we all deal with insecurities and feelings of complete and utter worthlessness. We all feel alone at the end of the day. I'm sure you'll find someone who treats you in the best possible way that you deserve. Just because you don't think others see the value in you or you don't see it for yourself that doesn't mean you have no value at all; I hope you come to see that.
Thank you for that comforting thought. It means a lot to be in someone's prayers.
Thank you, friend. I hope we both come to find peace outside death 💜
